findings.text: _within_tree duplicates reckon/crew/findings.py:1011 _within, a resolved containment test the same package already owns and reckon/_worker_fence.py:_within_any holds a third copy of; it neither wraps nor extends either owner, so a fourth copy of one predicate now has to be kept in step.

the docstring states history rather than the rule ("the case that used to be read as the fleet's own record"); the same shape is at tests/test_a_finding_on_a_runs_own_file_opens_its_repair.py:6 ("The reflex used to read any path..."), which is the changelog prose the repository's staged-path naming check bans.

assert WORKTREE_ONLY in calls[0]["advice"] (also :279 and :345) compares a path the test itself supplied against text the code echoes it into, so it holds under any implementation that opens a round for any reason; the independent guard is the len(calls) == 1 and status assertion beside it.
